Name: Caleb, Son of Hezron
Summary: Son of Hezron, also called Chelubai, father of a large Judahite family.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:18; 1 Chronicles 2:42: Son of Hezron, also called Chelubai, father of a large Judahite family.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Caleb stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
